description: A Toy to Please Chaste Ladies

participation.context: Read the title, and turned toward the Theatre.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the bill twice and did not go to the Rose. You took no name and no sum off it.

title: Read A Toy to Please Chaste Ladies twice

participation.context: Counted the bars and kept the rehearsal to the feast.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Played two measures, set the sixteen, and stopped them at one pass.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Spoke at half voice, palm to palm, and did not get a second time.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Stayed under the note the whole way.
participation.name: Nick Sorrell

relations.note: under the note, the whole way
relations.quote: Under the note. The whole way.

story.body: You counted the feast with Phillips, Burbage, and Nick, and you stopped when the music stopped. Nick held under the note. You kept the words of the fourteen off the page you were marking.

relations.note: under the note, the whole way
relations.quote: Under the note. The whole way.
